summary.tldr: Designates October 18 each year as Inherited Blood Disorders Awareness Day across Canada.
what_it_does: Designates October 18 in each year as Inherited Blood Disorders Awareness Day throughout Canada.
States that Inherited Blood Disorders Awareness Day is not a legal holiday or a non-juridical day.
summary.background: The bill’s summary says it creates a national awareness day for inherited blood disorders.
